ex.en: The two schools signed a reciprocal agreement on student exchange.
ex.zh: 两所学校签署了学生交换的互惠协议。

words.note: 强调双方对等互惠；名词形式是 reciprocity。

ex.en: Draw a vertical line from the top of the page to the bottom.
ex.zh: 从页面顶端到底部画一条垂直线。

words.note: 与 horizontal（水平的）相对；副词是 vertically。

ex.en: The store checks its inventory at the end of every month.
ex.zh: 这家店每月末核对库存。

words.note: take inventory 指盘点；也可指详细目录、清单。

ex.en: She still has a vivid memory of her first day at school.
ex.zh: 她对上学第一天仍记忆犹新。

words.note: 指色彩鲜艳或描述生动；副词 vividly，如 vividly remember。

ex.en: Her cheeks flushed with embarrassment when she heard her name.
ex.zh: 听到自己的名字时，她窘得脸都红了。

words.note: 表“脸红”常接 with；flush 也指表面齐平。

ex.en: As the only child, he is the sole heir to the family business.
ex.zh: 作为独子，他是家族企业的唯一继承人。

words.note: heir 后接介词 to；h 不发音，冠词用 an heir。

ex.en: He screwed the shelf firmly to the wall so it would not fall.
ex.zh: 他把架子牢牢拧在墙上，以免掉落。

words.note: 作动词指用螺钉固定；screw up 口语指搞糟。

ex.en: Every car should carry a first-aid kit and a spare tyre.
ex.zh: 每辆车都应备有急救包和一个备用轮胎。

words.note: 指成套工具或装备；kit out 表配备装备。

ex.en: He got the job by virtue of his long experience in teaching.
ex.zh: 他凭借长期的教学经验得到了这份工作。

words.note: by virtue of 是固定短语表“凭借、由于”，很常考。

ex.en: The doctor emphasized the importance of regular exercise and sleep.
ex.zh: 医生强调了规律运动和睡眠的重要性。

words.note: 名词形式是 emphasis，短语 put emphasis on。

ex.en: The company's annual turnover rose by ten percent last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年的年营业额增长了百分之十。

words.note: 可指营业额，也可指人员更替率，要看语境。

ex.en: All human beings are mortal, so we should value our time.
ex.zh: 人终有一死，所以我们应当珍惜时间。

words.note: 与 immortal（不朽的）相对；mortal enemy 指死敌。

ex.en: The trial received wide media coverage across the country.
ex.zh: 这场审判在全国获得了广泛的媒体报道。

words.note: 指新闻报道的覆盖，也可指保险的保障范围。

ex.en: It took me a while to figure out how the machine worked.
ex.zh: 我花了一会儿才弄明白这台机器怎么运作。

words.note: figure out 表“弄懂、算出”；figure 还可指数字、身材。

ex.en: The film describes the brutal reality of life during the war.
ex.zh: 这部影片描写了战争期间生活的残酷现实。

words.note: 语气比 cruel 更强，强调无情、野兽般；名词 brutality。

ex.en: There has been a slight improvement in his condition since yesterday.
ex.zh: 从昨天起他的病情略有好转。

words.note: not in the slightest 表“一点也不”；动词义“轻视”少用。

ex.en: The region is rich in iron ore and other minerals.
ex.zh: 这个地区富含铁矿石和其他矿物。

words.note: 多与金属名搭配，如 iron ore、copper ore，通常不可数。

ex.en: Several corrupt officials were removed from office after the investigation.
ex.zh: 调查之后，几名贪官被免职。

words.note: 兼指“腐败的”和“使腐化”；名词是 corruption。

ex.en: Bad weather precluded us from finishing the work on time.
ex.zh: 恶劣天气使我们无法按时完成工作。

words.note: preclude sb from doing 表使不能；较正式，近义 prevent。

ex.en: She had no previous experience, but she learned the job quickly.
ex.zh: 她此前没有经验，但很快就学会了这份工作。

words.note: 指紧接的前一个；previous to 表“在…之前”。

ex.en: The new regime promised to improve education and health care.
ex.zh: 新政权承诺改善教育和医疗。

words.note: 指政权或制度；也可指饮食、训练等固定制度。

ex.en: The disease can be transmitted through close contact with animals.
ex.zh: 这种病可通过与动物密切接触传播。

words.note: 指传送、传播；名词是 transmission。

ex.en: A ceremony was held to commemorate the soldiers who died in battle.
ex.zh: 人们举行仪式纪念阵亡的士兵。

words.note: 指用仪式或纪念物纪念；名词是 commemoration。

ex.en: Some experts argue that online learning is as effective as classrooms.
ex.zh: 一些专家认为线上学习与课堂学习同样有效。

words.note: argue with sb about sth 争吵；argue for 表支持。

ex.en: Rising energy consumption has become a serious problem for the city.
ex.zh: 不断上升的能源消耗已成为这座城市的严重问题。

words.note: 指消耗、消费；动词是 consume，consumer 指消费者。

ex.en: It is premature to draw any conclusion before all the data arrive.
ex.zh: 在全部数据到达之前就下结论为时过早。

words.note: pre- 加 mature，指过早、仓促，常与 decision 连用。

ex.en: This model is clearly superior to the one we bought last year.
ex.zh: 这个型号明显优于我们去年买的那个。

words.note: 比较时用 to 不用 than；反义词是 inferior。

ex.en: The long drought has destroyed most of the crops in the area.
ex.zh: 长期干旱毁掉了该地区大部分庄稼。

words.note: 常与 severe、long 搭配；gh 不发音，读作 /draʊt/。

ex.en: The library subscribes to several academic periodicals every year.
ex.zh: 图书馆每年订阅几种学术期刊。

words.note: 作名词指期刊；形容词指定期的，近义 periodic。

ex.en: Volunteers handed out leaflets about saving water in the square.
ex.zh: 志愿者在广场上散发了节水的传单。

words.note: leaf 加 -let（小），指散页印刷品；作动词指散发传单。
